rules.title: RBI V-CIP Live Geo-tagging and Liveness Verification
rules.decides: Requires live audio-visual interaction, liveness detection, and geo-tagging ensuring user is physically within Indian territory during digital KYC onboarding.

rules.title: UIDAI Explicit Consent and Number Masking
rules.decides: Requires explicit affirmative consent prior to collection and enforces masking of the first eight digits (XXXX-XXXX-1234) on all client UI surfaces and logs.

rules.title: MeitY DPDP Multilingual Notice and Consent Architecture
rules.decides: Requires itemized consent notice in clear, plain language in English and Eighth Schedule languages, with an accessible one-tap withdrawal path.

rules.title: RBI Digital Lending Key Fact Statement & Permission Fence
rules.decides: Mandates standardized Key Fact Statement (KFS) presentation before contract execution and strictly forbids accessing mobile contacts, media, or call logs.
